blocks.text: Piano Removal FAQs

items.q: 1) What types of pianos do you remove (upright, grand, etc.)?
a: We remove all piano types, including upright, grand, baby grand, spinet, and digital pianos. No piano is too big or small for our professional team.

items.q: 2) How do you ensure the safe removal of heavy pianos?
a: Our trained crews use specialized equipment like piano dollies, moving straps, and protective padding to safely move heavy pianos without damage to your property or the instrument.

items.q: 3) Can you remove pianos from upper floors or tight spaces?
a: Yes, we regularly remove pianos from upper floors, tight staircases, and challenging spaces using professional techniques and equipment to navigate difficult areas safely.

items.q: 4) What happens to the piano after it's removed?
a: Playable pianos are donated to schools/charities. Others are responsibly recycled, with metal, wood, and parts separated for eco-friendly disposal. We minimize landfill waste.

items.q: 5) What areas do you serve for Piano Removal Services?
a: We serve Toronto and the surrounding GTA areas. Contact us with your location and we’ll confirm if we service your area.

items.q: 6) Do I need to prepare the piano for removal?
a: Just clear a path. Our team handles everything else, including disassembly (if needed). No special preparation required from you.

items.q: 7) Is your piano removal service insured?
a: Yes, we’re fully insured for both property damage and liability, giving you complete peace of mind during the removal process.
